info.title: DiffScope Synthesis Platform API
info.description: DSSP HTTP API surface represented by this service. A server implementation can support a subset of the broader DSSP API.

servers.description: Default local server URL. The actual host and port are configured by the service.

get.description: Returns metadata for every registered architecture.
Returns metadata for one registered architecture.
Returns singers from every registered architecture.
Returns singers from one registered architecture.
Returns one singer from one registered architecture.
Returns the avatar URL for one singer.
Returns the background image URL for one singer.
Returns demo audio entries for one singer.

post.description: Returns the environment tag for a synthesis context.
Generates pronunciation candidates for lyric input. Set stream to true to request newline-delimited JSON events.
Generates phoneme notes from pronunciation notes. Set stream to true to request newline-delimited JSON events.
Generates phoneme timing for duration notes. Set stream to true to receive newline-delimited JSON events.
Generates requested parameter values. Set stream to true to receive newline-delimited JSON events.
Generates encoded audio as a data URL. Set stream to true to receive newline-delimited JSON events.

get.description: Returns the available note, tempo, and pitch extractors.
Returns metadata for one note extractor.
Returns metadata for one tempo extractor.
Returns metadata for one pitch extractor.

post.description: Extracts note timing and pitch from audio.
Extracts one global tempo value from audio.
Extracts a segmented pitch curve from audio.

SingerID.name: singer_id
SingerID.description: Singer identifier understood by the selected architecture.

ExtractorID.name: extractor_id
ExtractorID.description: Extractor identifier within the selected extraction capability.

ArchitectureList.description: Architecture metadata from every registered architecture.

SingerList.description: Singer metadata from every registered architecture.

ArchSingerList.description: Singer metadata from one registered architecture.

EnvTagResult.description: Environment tag for the supplied synthesis context.

PronunciationComplete.description: Pronunciation generation result. Non-streaming requests return a complete JSON response. Streaming requests return newline-delimited JSON progress and completion events.

PhonemeComplete.description: Phoneme generation result. Non-streaming requests return a complete JSON response. Streaming requests return newline-delimited JSON progress and completion events.

DurationResult.description: Duration generation result. Non-streaming requests return a complete JSON response. Streaming requests return newline-delimited JSON progress and completion events.

ParameterResult.description: Parameter generation result. Non-streaming requests return a complete JSON response. Streaming requests return newline-delimited JSON progress and completion events.

AudioResult.description: Audio generation result. Non-streaming requests return a complete JSON response. Streaming requests return newline-delimited JSON progress and completion events.

id.description: Extractor identifier within its extraction capability.

preferred_audio_sample_rate.description: Preferred input audio sample rate in Hz.

extractor.description: Identifier of an extractor for the requested capability.

audio_url.description: URL of the audio to analyze.

tempo.description: Estimated global tempo in beats per minute.

segments.description: Voiced pitch segments. The array can be empty when no pitch is detected.

sample_rate.description: Number of pitch samples per second.

gap.description: Number of missing pitch frames before this segment. For the first segment, frames are counted from the start of the audio. For later segments, the start frame is the previous segment start plus its pitch value count plus this gap.

id.description: Singer identifier understood by the selected architecture.

mix_group.description: Identifier shared by singers whose inference resources can be mixed.

stream.description: When true, the response uses application/x-ndjson and emits progress events.

EnvTag.description: Environment tag for a synthesis context.

Mix.description: Per-frame singer mix data. Each value must be in [0, 1]. Each row must contain exactly singers.length - 1 values, and the sum of values in each row must be less than or equal to 1.

ParameterMap.description: Open string-keyed parameter map. Supported keys and semantic requirements are defined by the selected architecture.

AudioParameterMap.description: Open string-keyed audio parameter map. Supported keys and semantic requirements are defined by the selected architecture.
